claims.text: The predictive approach is based on machine-learning models trained on high-entropy-alloy datasets.
The approach will accurately identify high-entropy alloys with low phonon thermal conductivity.
Elemental properties interact in ways that affect lattice dynamics in high-entropy alloys.
The approach is trained on a diverse dataset of high-entropy alloys with known thermal-conductivity properties.
The complex lattice structure of high-entropy alloys affects phonon scattering.
The complex lattice structure of high-entropy alloys affects thermal conductivity.
The predictive approach can learn patterns correlated with low phonon thermal conductivity.
Specific elemental combinations may correlate with low phonon thermal conductivity.
Lattice distortions may correlate with low phonon thermal conductivity.
The approach will improve identification of low-phonon-thermal-conductivity materials by 20–30% relative to current predictive methods.
The approach is applicable only to high-entropy alloys with compositions and structures similar to those represented in its training dataset.
The accuracy of the approach may depend on the quality and diversity of the training dataset.
The complexity of lattice dynamics in high-entropy alloys may affect the accuracy of the approach.
A lack of significantly lower measured thermal conductivity in the predicted-low group relative to a predicted-high control group would falsify the hypothesis.
